name: Four Seasons Resort Bali at Sayan
positioning: Riverside villa resort in the Ayung River valley near Ubud, Bali, with Sacred River Spa and rice bowl-shaped architecture
best_for: Travelers seeking a wellness-focused stay in the Ayung River valley
Guests who want a villa base near Ubud

facts.text: The resort has a total of 60 rooms.
The resort is 35 kilometres (22 miles) northeast of Ngurah Rai International Airport.
The resort is 6 kilometres (3.7 miles) from central Ubud.
Ayung Terrace is an open-air treetop dining space serving modern Indonesian cuisine.
Riverside is a Mediterranean restaurant with dishes from Italy, Spain, France, Lebanon and Greece.
Jati Bar is a teakwood lobby lounge that offers afternoon tea.
The Sacred River Spa has 7 spa villas.
The resort offers a daily shuttle bus to and from Ubud Centre.
Pici Pici Kids Club is open daily from 9:00 am to 6:00 pm.

highlights.text: The architecture is described as dramatic “Rice Bowl” architecture with an entrance through a bridge.
The resort has a gravity-defying rooftop lotus pond.
Sokasi serves an intimate seven-course Balinese dinner cooked in front of guests in an open kitchen.
Complimentary yoga and meditation classes are offered.
Ibu Fera, a former Buddhist nun, is the resident wellness mentor.

considerations.text: The resort is 75 minutes by car from Ngurah Rai International Airport.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
